## What changes?

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior or resource.

## Related issue

Closes # (if applicable)

## Validation

Describe checks actually performed, their results, and any limitations. For prompts, list tested model/version and settings, or explicitly say the example is untested.

## Checklist

- [ ] This change is focused and documented.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks, or explained why they do not apply.
- [ ] I own the contributed material or included its source, license, and required attribution.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unlicensed reference assets are included.
- [ ] Previews and model-compatibility claims are accurate and clearly labeled.
